about:
Ramco Automotive, based in Miami, Florida, was founded in 2007 by industry veterans with 40 years of combined experience. The company began as an independent manufacturer and distributor of electrical and electronic replacement parts for motor vehicles.

The company produces a range of sensors and components including crankshaft position sensors, idle air control valves, camshaft position sensors, fuel pressure regulators, coolant temperature sensors, ignition control modules, ignition coils, and knock detonation sensors. Ramco operates an online platform that serves distributors and retailers, offering both its own RAMCO brand and products from other aftermarket manufacturers. The catalog complies with ACES and PIES data management standards.

Ramco serves the automotive aftermarket, original equipment (OE), and original equipment service (OES) markets. Its customer base includes distributors and retailers across the United States, Latin America, Europe, and the Middle East.

The company emphasizes honesty, quality, reliability, and timely delivery. Its mission is to be the leading independent supplier to the automotive aftermarket by providing high-quality products, competitive pricing, and strong customer service while operating in an environmentally responsible manner.
